svg.title: Synthetic LiDAR forest inventory demonstration
svg.desc: A four-panel dashboard showing synthetic terrain, surface elevation, canopy height and field-validation priority rankings.
svg.text: Synthetic raster scene · 2 m grid · results are workflow demonstration only
Score combines tall-canopy share (55%), P95 height (25%) and forest cover (20%). It is not a harvest instruction.
Portfolio workflow: validate → derive CHM → calculate enclosure metrics → test sensitivity → prioritise field validation.
